correctness.rationale:
For \(E=kB+kC\), direct multiplication in characteristic \(2\) gives \([B,C]=B\), so \(E\) is Lie closed. For \(v=(x,y)^{\mathsf T}\), the parameter-to-value matrix has determinant \(x^2\); hence all directions with \(x
e0\) impose no reflexivity constraint, while the direction \(x=0\) forces equality of the two entries in the second column. This yields the stated hull exactly. Two explicit hull elements have commutator outside that hull. Dimension \(1\) cannot fail because all endomorphism commutators vanish.
